source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of positive impacts (PDF 186-187).

items: Maloomat tak rasai: internet taleem ki rukawatein todta hai; Coursera aur edX jaise platforms door daraz ilaqon ke students ko bari universities ke courses karne dete hain.
Baat cheet: log duniya bhar mein jaldi jurte hain; social media ne #MeToo jaisi tehreekon ko phailaya, aur Pakistan mein 2014 ke Peshawar school hamle ke baad aagahi aur yakjehti barhayi.
Maeeshati tarraqi: nayi sanatein aur naukriyan; Daraz jaise e-commerce platforms chhote Pakistani karobaron ko mulk bhar aur bahar gahakon tak pohanchate hain.

blocks.prompt: Muashre par computing ka musbat asar kaunsa hai (MCQ 8)? Computing ne baat cheet ko kaise mutasir kiya (short question 6)?
blocks.explanation: (b) maloomat tak behtar rasai. Baat cheet ab foran aur aalmi hai: email, messaging aur video calls faaslon ke paar khandanon aur karobaron ko jorti hain, aur social media khayalat aur tehreekon ko tezi se phailata hai, agarche ghalat maloomat bhi phailata hai.

items: Musbat asraat: maloomat tak rasai, aalmi baat cheet, maeeshati tarraqi.
